references.author: Colin P. McNally, Wladimir Lyra and Jean-Claude Passy
references.title: A Well-Posed Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability Test and Comparison
references.review_scope: Read original sections1–3 on matching smooth finite-domain models and growth diagnostics; arXiv journal metadata checked. Our forced incompressible model is distinct.

review.ja: 原著の滑らかな層・有限領域・成長測定の議論を確認。本例は独自の強制非圧縮系です。
review.en: Selected original methodology read; our incompressible forced inputs differ from its compressible benchmark.

references.author: Antonio Celani, Andrea Mazzino and Lara Vozella
references.title: Rayleigh–Taylor turbulence in two dimensions
references.review_scope: Read original pp1–2 governing equations1–2 and doubly periodic Boussinesq setup. No original turbulent-run reproduction.

review.ja: 原著のBoussinesq方程式と周期設定を確認。本例の滑らかな定常維持二層と線形参照は独自です。
review.en: Original Boussinesq equations and periodic setup read; our smooth maintained layers and linear reference are constructed here.

read_scope: Selected primary PDF text; no full-paper audit or claim that original input data were reproduced. Author KH download page served an anti-bot response; no author dataset was acquired.

original_model_derivation.kh: Omega=-Delta psi; base U=tanh(sin(y)/delta), Uprimeprime analytic. Perturbation omega_t=-U omega_x-Uprimeprime psi_x-adv(omega)+nu Delta omega. Full steady base is maintained by explicit body force -nu Uprimeprime.
original_model_derivation.rt: Buoyancy b=b0(y)+theta, b0=B tanh(sin(y)/delta), rho/rho0=1-b/g in Boussinesq approximation. Explicit source -kappa b0_second maintains the smooth two-interface base; hydrostatic pressure removes b0 vertical force. omega_t=-adv(omega)+nu Delta omega+theta_x; theta_t=-adv(theta)-v b0prime+kappa Delta theta.
original_model_derivation.reference: Independently derived continuous Fourier-Galerkin equations at kx=1 with matrix exponentials; physical-space primary uses nonlinear centered shared-face fluxes/Heun. Linearization controlled by amplitude halving; never called an independent nonlinear engine.
